content.content: The single-document read crosses the jj seam: it runs as one spawned `jj` crossing under the caller-supplied binary and root, holding nothing of its own, and the crossing names the document it reads. The set read is not this crossing.
content.rationale: S3 (xmxpvqzs) fixes that every jj interaction crosses a spawned process, and the single-document read is one; S3-explicit (vyquqmoo) fixes that binary and root are supplied by the caller with nothing searching PATH inside the boundary, and S3-stateless (lvkukpyw) that the runner holds only what it was given. S3-read (qrwtzxpn) fixes the command the crossing names — reading a file at a revision; this node fixes that the single-document read crosses through it. The set read is S2-read-set's and is not this crossing. S2-ifs keeps the read reach its own, so the crossing is the read's, not borrowed from the log, op-log or status crossings.
